name: GitHub
description: Navigate GitHub repositories: switch tabs, search code, open files, list issues and pull requests.
author: WebMCP Anywhere

tools.name: gh_repo
tools.title: Current repository
tools.description: Read which GitHub repository the current page belongs to. Returns `repo` ("owner/name"), `description`, `stars`, `default_branch_or_ref` (from the branch picker, if visible) and `url`. Read-only.

tools.name: gh_switch_tab
tools.title: Switch repository tab
tools.description: Switch to a tab of the current GitHub repository: code, issues, pull-requests, actions, projects, wiki, security, or pulse. Navigates within the repo (page updates). Returns the resulting page `title`.

tab.description: Which repository tab to open. Use "pull-requests" for PRs.

tools.name: gh_search_repo
tools.title: Search in repository
tools.description: Search code, issues and more within the current GitHub repository (owner/name derived from the URL). Navigates to GitHub's search results page scoped to this repo; call gh_search_results afterwards to read the hits. Returns the URL that was opened.

query.description: Search terms or GitHub search syntax, e.g. "registerTool path:src".

tools.name: gh_search_results
tools.title: Read search results
tools.description: On a GitHub search results page, read the result list. Returns `titles` (file paths or issue titles) and `urls` arrays in on-page order. Read-only.

tools.name: gh_open_file
tools.title: Open file
tools.description: Open a file from the current GitHub repository at its default branch (HEAD) by path, e.g. "src/index.ts" or "README.md". Navigates to the blob view. Returns the URL that was opened.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, e.g. "packages/core/src/index.ts".

tools.name: gh_list_files
tools.title: List files in current directory
tools.description: On a GitHub repository code or tree page, list the entries of the directory being shown. Returns `names` (file/folder names) and `urls`. Read-only.

tools.name: gh_read_file
tools.title: Read file contents
tools.description: On a GitHub blob (file) page, read the file's `path` and its text `content` (first 50 lines are guaranteed; long files are truncated by the page's virtualised viewer). Read-only.

tools.name: gh_list_issues
tools.title: List issues or pull requests
tools.description: On a GitHub issues or pull requests list page, read the visible items. Returns parallel arrays `titles` and `urls` (index 1 = first). Read-only.

tools.name: gh_open_issue
tools.title: Open issue/PR by number
tools.description: Open an issue or pull request of the current repository by its number (GitHub redirects /issues/N to /pull/N when it is a PR). Navigates. Returns the URL that was opened.

number.description: Issue or pull request number, e.g. 42.
